brief.headline: Cut Dextrose price by 3.0% to match our best rate and save ₹1.26 Cr/yr — you are growing fast and we hold 56% of our Dextrose volume with you, making this the easiest win for both sides.

priceAsk.basis: We already pay ₹66.48/KG to Sayaji Industries Limited for comparable Dextrose; your rate runs 3.0% above that benchmark. The India export unit value sits at 42.95 ₹/kg, well below both prices, so ₹66.48/KG remains commercially attractive.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep current 30 Days After Receipt terms
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹1.74 Cr working capital already tied up; no ask to worsen terms

brief.financialLeverage: Gujarat Ambuja is financially robust: ₹6031.59 Cr revenue, 6.9% net margin, 10.1% EBITDA margin, 12.5% return on capital, and low debt at 0.13x debt-to-equity. Health score is B (64/100) with no red flags. Our ₹21.21 Cr spend represents just 0.35% of their revenue, so we are not material to them individually. However, they are growing at 23.5% per year and will value volume commitment. Their strong balance sheet means they can afford the 3.0% price cut without distress, and the size disparity means we push firmly on price but must also dangle volume growth to make the deal attractive.

evidence.point: We pay ₹68.45/KG for Dextrose from Gujarat Ambuja, which is 3.0% above our best price
Sayaji Industries delivers the same material at our best-in-house rate
India export unit value for Dextrose runs far below both our rates
Gujarat Ambuja is our dominant Dextrose supplier, concentrating risk and giving us serious leverage to rebalance
evidence.figure: ₹21.21 Cr annual spend, 56% share of material

evidence.point: They are growing revenue rapidly and will trade price for committed volume
Their financials are solid — margins healthy, leverage negligible, rating stable
evidence.figure: 6.9% net margin, 10.1% EBITDA margin, 0.13x debt-to-equity, B (64/100) health score

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker, ₹2359.06 Cr revenue, B (62/100) health — established dextrose/sorbitol supplier, a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja.

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist, ₹821.13 Cr revenue, C (53/100) health — growing capacity in starch and dextrose.

alternates.name: Roquette India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Indian arm of global starch major, ₹2898.05 Cr revenue — pharma-grade dextrose/excipients, premium quality and very reliable.

risks: Gujarat Ambuja supplies 56% of our Dextrose volume (₹21.21 Cr); pushing too hard without a qualified second source in place risks supply continuity if they walk.
We represent only 0.35% of their ₹6031.59 Cr revenue — we have limited commercial importance to them, so volume commitment (not just price pressure) is essential to secure the cut.

Market export price of 42.95 ₹/kg is far below both our ₹68.45/KG and the ₹66.48/KG target — if they cite export floors, counter that our benchmark is a proven Indian supplier price, not export parity.
Their 23.5% growth trajectory means they may prioritise higher-margin customers or export markets over a 3.0% domestic price concession unless we lock in multi-year volume.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but at ₹68.45/KG you're running 3.0% above the ₹66.48/KG we pay Sayaji for identical Dextrose — let's close that ₹1.26 Cr gap, and in return we'll commit the volume growth your 23.5% trajectory needs.
